excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
To the attention of EL devs!

We're making a renaming of `DepositRequest` to `DepositReceipts` as a quick fix to facilitate a smooth interop between CL and EL clients during devnet-0. More details are in the PR description: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/544
